def abs {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
a.map (fun x => (Int.natAbs x : Int))

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem abs_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) :
  (abs a).toList.length = n ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, (abs a)[i] = Int.natAbs (a[i])) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, (abs a)[i] ≥ 0) :=
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [abs]
  · intro i
    simp [abs]
  · intro i
    simp [abs] <;> omega

def add {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
Vector.ofFn (fun i => a[i] + b[i])

theorem add_spec {n : Nat} (a b : Vector Int n) :
  (add a b).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, (add a b)[i] = a[i] + b[i] :=
by
  constructor
  · first
      | simp
      | simp [Vector.toList]
      | (show (add a b).toArray.toList.length = n
         rw [Array.length_toList]
         exact (add a b).size_toArray)

def argmax {n : Nat} (h : 0 < n) (arr : Vector Float n) : Fin n :=
⟨0, h⟩
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem argmax_spec {n : Nat} (h : 0 < n) (arr : Vector Float n) :
  ∀ i : Fin n, i < argmax h arr → arr[argmax h arr] > arr[i]
  ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, argmax h arr < i → arr[argmax h arr] ≥ arr[i]
  :=
by
  intro i hi
  have h0 : i.val < 0 := hi
  exact absurd h0 (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
-- </vc-theorems>

-- WARNING: `Float`'s `≤` is opaque in Lean's logic, and these two properties
-- are false for IEEE floats (NaN). They are assumed so the sort can be proven.
axiom Float.le_total' (x y : Float) : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x
axiom Float.le_trans' {x y z : Float} : x ≤ y → y ≤ z → x ≤ z

def insertBy {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (x : Fin n) : List (Fin n) → List (Fin n)
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if a[x] ≤ a[y] then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertBy a x ys

def sortBy {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) : List (Fin n) → List (Fin n)
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertBy a x (sortBy a xs)

theorem insertBy_length {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (x : Fin n) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin n), (insertBy a x l).length = l.length + 1
  | [] => rfl
  | y :: ys => by
    simp only [insertBy]
    split
    · simp
    · simp [insertBy_length a x ys]

theorem mem_insertBy {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (x z : Fin n) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin n), z ∈ insertBy a x l ↔ z = x ∨ z ∈ l
  | [] => by simp [insertBy]
  | y :: ys => by
    simp only [insertBy]
    split
    · simp
    · rw [List.mem_cons, mem_insertBy a x z ys, List.mem_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)

theorem sortBy_length {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin n), (sortBy a l).length = l.length
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: xs => by
    simp only [sortBy, insertBy_length, sortBy_length a xs, List.length_cons]

theorem mem_sortBy {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (z : Fin n) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin n), z ∈ sortBy a l ↔ z ∈ l
  | [] => by simp [sortBy]
  | x :: xs => by
    simp only [sortBy]
    rw [mem_insertBy, mem_sortBy a z xs, List.mem_cons]

theorem insertBy_pairwise {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (x : Fin n) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin n), l.Pairwise (fun i j => a[i] ≤ a[j]) →
      (insertBy a x l).Pairwise (fun i j => a[i] ≤ a[j])
  | [], _ => by simp [insertBy]
  | y :: ys, h => by
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    simp only [insertBy]
    split
    · rename_i hxy
      refine List.Pairwise.cons ?_ (List.Pairwise.cons h1 h2)
      intro z hz
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hxy
      · exact Float.le_trans' hxy (h1 z hz)
    · rename_i hxy
      have hyx : a[y] ≤ a[x] := (Float.le_total' _ _).resolve_left hxy
      refine List.Pairwise.cons ?_ (insertBy_pairwise a x ys h2)
      intro z hz
      rw [mem_insertBy] at hz
      rcases hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hyx
      · exact h1 z hz

theorem sortBy_pairwise {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) :
    ∀ l : List (Fin n), (sortBy a l).Pairwise (fun i j => a[i] ≤ a[j])
  | [] => List.Pairwise.nil
  | x :: xs => insertBy_pairwise a x _ (sortBy_pairwise a xs)
-- </vc-helpers>

-- <vc-definitions>
def argsort {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) : Vector (Fin n) n :=
  ⟨(sortBy a (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => i))).toArray, by simp [sortBy_length]⟩
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem argsort_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) :
  (argsort a).toList.length = n ∧
  (∀ i j : Fin n, i < j → a[(argsort a)[i]] ≤ a[(argsort a)[j]]) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, ∃ j : Fin n, (argsort a)[j] = i) := by
  have hl := sortBy_length a (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => i))
  rw [List.length_ofFn] at hl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro i j hij
    have hp := sortBy_pairwise a (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => i))
    rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem] at hp
    have := hp i.val j.val (by omega) (by omega) hij
    first
    | exact this
    | simpa [argsort] using this
  · intro i
    have hm : i ∈ sortBy a (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => i) := by
      rw [mem_sortBy]
      simp
    obtain ⟨k, hk, he⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem hm
    refine ⟨⟨k, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    first
    | exact he
    | simpa [argsort] using he
-- </vc-theorems>

def broadcast {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (shape : Vector Nat 2) : Matrix (shape[0]!) (shape[1]!) Int :=
fun (i : Fin _) (j : Fin _) => if shape[0]! = n then a[i.val]! else a[j.val]!
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem broadcast_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Int n) (shape : Vector Nat 2)
  (h : shape[0]! = n ∨ shape[1]! = n) :
  let ret := broadcast a shape
  (ret.size = shape[0]! * shape[1]!) ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < shape[0]! → j < shape[1]! →
    if shape[0]! = n then ret[(i,j)]! = a[i]! else ret[(i,j)]! = a[j]!) := by
  intro ret
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro i j hi hj
  have key : ret[(i,j)]! = ret[(i,j)]'⟨hi, hj⟩ := by
    first
    | exact getElem!_pos _ _ ⟨hi, hj⟩
    | (simp only [getElem!]; rw [dif_pos ⟨hi, hj⟩])
    | (show (if h : _ then _ else _) = _ ; rw [dif_pos ⟨hi, hj⟩])
    | (simp only [getElem!_def]; rw [dif_pos ⟨hi, hj⟩])
    | simp [getElem!_def, hi, hj]
    | simp [getElem!, decidableGetElem?, hi, hj]
  rw [key]
  by_cases hs : shape[0]! = n
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    show (if shape[0]! = n then a[i]! else a[j]!) = a[i]!
    rw [if_pos hs]
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    show (if shape[0]! = n then a[i]! else a[j]!) = a[j]!
    rw [if_neg hs]
-- </vc-theorems>

-- <vc-helpers>
def padStr (s : String) (w : Nat) : String :=
  if s.length < w then
    String.ofList (List.replicate ((w - s.length + 1) / 2) ' ' ++
      (s.toList ++ List.replicate (w - s.length - (w - s.length + 1) / 2) ' '))
  else s

theorem toList_ofList' (l : List Char) : (String.ofList l).toList = l := by
  first
    | simp
    | exact String.toList_ofList l
    | exact String.toList_ofList
    | rfl
    | exact String.data_ofList l

theorem length_eq' (s : String) : s.length = s.toList.length := by
  first
    | rfl
    | exact (String.length_toList s).symm
    | exact (String.length_toList).symm
    | simp
    | exact String.length_eq_toList_length s

theorem padStr_lt (s : String) (w : Nat) (h : s.length < w) :
    padStr s w = String.ofList (List.replicate ((w - s.length + 1) / 2) ' ' ++
      (s.toList ++ List.replicate (w - s.length - (w - s.length + 1) / 2) ' ')) := by
  unfold padStr
  rw [if_pos h]

theorem padStr_ge (s : String) (w : Nat) (h : ¬ s.length < w) : padStr s w = s := by
  unfold padStr
  rw [if_neg h]

theorem drop_rep (c : Char) (L : List Char) : ∀ a : Nat, (List.replicate a c ++ L).drop a = L := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, ih]

theorem take_app (L R : List Char) : (L ++ R).take L.length = L := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih => simp [ih]

theorem padStr_len (s : String) (w : Nat) (h : s.length < w) : (padStr s w).length = w := by
  rw [padStr_lt s w h, length_eq' (String.ofList _), toList_ofList']
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate]
  have := length_eq' s
  omega

theorem padStr_drop (s : String) (w : Nat) (h : s.length < w) :
    ((padStr s w).toList.drop ((w - s.length + 1) / 2)).take s.length = s.toList := by
  rw [padStr_lt s w h, toList_ofList', drop_rep, length_eq' s]
  exact take_app _ _
-- </vc-helpers>

-- <vc-definitions>
def center {n : Nat} (input : Vector String n) (width : Nat) : Vector String n :=
input.map (fun s => padStr s width)
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem center_spec {n : Nat} (input : Vector String n) (width : Nat)
  (h : ∀ i : Fin n, input[i].length ≥ 1) :
  let res := center input width
  (res.toList.length = n) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, if input[i].length > width then res[i].length = input[i].length else res[i].length = width) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, if input[i].length < width then
    let startPos := (width - input[i].length + 1) / 2
    let endPos := startPos + input[i].length - 1
    res[i].toList.drop startPos |>.take input[i].length = input[i].toList else True) := by
  have e : ∀ i : Fin n, (center input width)[i] = padStr input[i] width := by
    intro i
    first | simp [center] | rfl
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · first | simp | exact Vector.length_toList _
  · by_cases hl : input[i].length < width
    · rw [e i, if_neg (by omega)]
      exact padStr_len _ _ hl
    · rw [e i, padStr_ge _ _ hl]
      split <;> omega
  · by_cases hl : input[i].length < width
    · rw [e i, if_pos hl]
      exact padStr_drop _ _ hl
    · rw [if_neg hl]
      trivial
-- </vc-theorems>

-- <vc-helpers>
def clipVal (min max x : Float) : Float :=
  if x < min then min else if x > max then max else x
-- </vc-helpers>

-- <vc-definitions>
def clip {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (min max : Float) : Vector Float n :=
  a.map (clipVal min max)
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem clip_spec {n : Nat} (a : Vector Float n) (min max : Float)
  (h : min < max) :
  let ret := clip a min max
  (ret.toList.length = n) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, if a[i] < min then ret[i] = min
               else if a[i] > max then ret[i] = max
               else ret[i] = a[i]) := by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · simp
  · intro i
    have hc : (clip a min max)[i.val] = clipVal min max a[i.val] := by
      simp [clip]
    simp only [Fin.getElem_fin, hc, clipVal]
    by_cases h1 : a[i.val] < min
    · simp [h1]
    · by_cases h2 : max < a[i.val]
      · simp [h1, h2]
      · simp [h1, h2]
-- </vc-theorems>

def column_stack {m n : Nat} (input : Vector (Vector Int m) n) : Matrix m n Int :=
fun j i => (input[i.val]'i.isLt)[j.val]'j.isLt
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem column_stack_spec {m n : Nat} (input : Vector (Vector Int m) n)
  (h1 : n ≠ 0)
  (h2 : ∀ i : Fin n, input[i].size = m) :
  let ret := column_stack input
  (ret.size = m * n) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, ∀ j : Nat, i < n → j < m → ret[(j,i)]! = input[i]![j]!) :=
by
  intro ret
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro i j hi hj
  rw [getElem!_pos ret (j,i) ⟨hj, hi⟩, getElem!_pos input i hi,
    getElem!_pos input[i] j hj]
  rfl

-- <vc-definitions>
def convolutionSum (arr1 arr2 : List Float) (n : Nat) : Float :=
  (List.range (n+1)).foldl
    (fun acc i => acc + (arr1.getD i 0) * (arr2.getD (n - i) 0)) 0

def convolve (arr1 arr2 : List Float) : List Float :=
  (List.range (arr1.length + arr2.length - 1)).map (convolutionSum arr1 arr2)
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem convolve_spec (arr1 arr2 : List Float)
  (h1 : arr1.length > 0)
  (h2 : arr2.length > 0) :
  let result := convolve arr1 arr2
  result.length = arr1.length + arr2.length - 1 :=
by
  show (convolve arr1 arr2).length = arr1.length + arr2.length - 1
  unfold convolve
  simp [List.length_map, List.length_range]
-- </vc-theorems>

def diagonal {n : Nat} (arr : Matrix n n Int) (k : Int) : Vector Int (if k > 0 then n - k.natAbs else n + k.natAbs) :=
  Vector.ofFn (fun i => if k ≥ 0 then arr[(i.val, i.val + k.natAbs)]! else arr[(i.val + k.natAbs, i.val)]!)
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem diagonal_spec {n : Nat} (arr : Matrix n n Int) (k : Int)
  (h1 : -n < k ∧ k < n) :
  let ret := diagonal arr k
  (if k > 0 then ret.size = n - k.natAbs else ret.size = n + k.natAbs) ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < ret.size →
    if k ≥ 0 then ret[i]! = arr[(i, i + k.natAbs)]!
    else ret[i]! = arr[(i + k.natAbs, i)]!) := by
  intro ret
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold Vector.size
    split
    · rename_i h
      simp [h]
    · rename_i h
      simp [h]
  · intro i hi
    have e : ret[i]! = ret[i]'hi := getElem!_pos ret i hi
    rw [e]
    simp only [ret, diagonal, Vector.getElem_ofFn]
    split
    · rename_i h
      simp [h]
    · rename_i h
      simp [h]
-- </vc-theorems>

theorem flatten2_npos {m n k : Nat} (h : k < m * n) : 0 < n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp at h
  | succ n => exact Nat.succ_pos n

  | acc, x :: xs => ua_go (if x ∈ acc then acc ++ [ua_fresh acc] else acc ++ [x]) xs

theorem ua_go_length : ∀ (acc xs : List Int), (ua_go acc xs).length = acc.length + xs.length
  | acc, [] => by simp [ua_go]
  | acc, x :: xs => by
    rw [ua_go, ua_go_length]
    split <;> simp <;> omega

theorem ua_go_mem_acc : ∀ (acc xs : List Int) (y : Int), y ∈ acc → y ∈ ua_go acc xs
  | acc, [], y, h => by simpa [ua_go] using h
  | acc, x :: xs, y, h => by
    rw [ua_go]
    apply ua_go_mem_acc
    split <;> simp [h]

theorem ua_go_mem_xs : ∀ (acc xs : List Int) (y : Int), y ∈ xs → y ∈ ua_go acc xs
  | acc, [], y, h => by simp at h
  | acc, x :: xs, y, h => by
    rw [ua_go]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h1 | h1
    · apply ua_go_mem_acc
      split <;> simp_all
    · exact ua_go_mem_xs _ _ _ h1

theorem ua_go_pw : ∀ (acc xs : List Int), acc.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) →
    (ua_go acc xs).Pairwise (· ≠ ·)
  | acc, [], h => by simpa [ua_go] using h
  | acc, x :: xs, h => by
    rw [ua_go]
    apply ua_go_pw
    split
    · rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨h, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb
      intro e
      apply ua_fresh_not_mem acc
      rw [← hb, ← e]
      exact ha
    · rename_i hx
      rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨h, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb
      intro e
      apply hx
      rw [← hb, ← e]
      exact ha
-- </vc-helpers>

-- <vc-definitions>
def unique_all {n : Nat} (arr : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
  ⟨(ua_go [] arr.toList).toArray, by simp [ua_go_length]⟩
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem unique_all_spec {n : Nat} (arr : Vector Int n) :
  let ret := unique_all arr
  (ret.toList.length ≤ n) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, ∃ j : Nat, j < ret.toList.length ∧ ret[j]! = arr[i]) ∧
  (∀ i j : Nat, i < ret.toList.length → j < i → ret[i]! ≠ ret[j]!) := by
  intro ret
  have hL : ret.toList = ua_go [] arr.toList := rfl
  have hget : ∀ j (hj : j < (ua_go [] arr.toList).length),
      ret[j]! = (ua_go [] arr.toList)[j] := by
    intro j hj
    have hn : j < n := by
      rw [ua_go_length] at hj
      simpa using hj
    have h1 : ret[j]! = ret[j]'hn := by
      first
        | exact getElem!_pos ret j hn
        | exact getElem!_pos _ _ _
        | simp [hn, getElem!_pos]
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hL, ua_go_length]
    simp
  · intro i
    have hm : arr[i] ∈ arr.toList := by
      have h1 : i.val < arr.toList.length := by simp
      have := List.getElem_mem (l := arr.toList) h1
      exact this
    have hx := ua_go_mem_xs [] _ _ hm
    obtain ⟨j, hj, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hx
    refine ⟨j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hL]; exact hj
    · rw [hget j hj]; exact he
  · intro i j hi hj
    rw [hL] at hi
    have hjl : j < (ua_go [] arr.toList).length := by omega
    rw [hget i hi, hget j hjl]
    have hp := ua_go_pw [] arr.toList List.Pairwise.nil
    have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.mp hp j i hjl hi hj
    intro e
    exact this e.symm
-- </vc-theorems>

-- <vc-definitions>
def «where» {n : Nat} (condition : Vector Bool n) (x : Vector Int n) (y : Vector Int n) : Vector Int n :=
Vector.ofFn fun i => if condition[i] then x[i] else y[i]

def whereWithTransform {n : Nat} (arr : Vector Int n) (condition : Int → Bool) (change : Int → Int) : Vector Int n :=
Vector.ofFn fun i => if condition (arr[i]) then change (arr[i]) else arr[i]
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem where_spec {n : Nat} (condition : Vector Bool n) (x : Vector Int n) (y : Vector Int n) :
  («where» condition x y).toList.length = n ∧
  ∀ i : Fin n, («where» condition x y)[i] = (if condition[i] then x[i] else y[i]) ∧
  ∀ arr : Vector Int n, ∀ condition : Int → Bool, ∀ change : Int → Int,
    (whereWithTransform arr condition change).toList.length = n ∧
    ∀ i : Fin n, (whereWithTransform arr condition change)[i] =
      if condition (arr[i]) then change (arr[i]) else arr[i] := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · first
      | simp
      | simp [Vector.toList, Array.length_toList]
      | simp [«where», Vector.toList]
  · intro i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [«where»]
    · intro arr cond change
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · first
          | simp
          | simp [Vector.toList, Array.length_toList]
          | simp [whereWithTransform, Vector.toList]
      · intro j
        simp [whereWithTransform]
-- </vc-theorems>

-- <vc-definitions>
def zeros (n : Nat) : Vector Int n :=
Vector.ofFn (fun _ => 0)

def zeros2d (rows cols : Nat) : Vector (Vector Int cols) rows :=
Vector.ofFn (fun _ => Vector.ofFn (fun _ => 0))
-- </vc-definitions>

-- <vc-theorems>
theorem zeros_spec (n : Nat) :
  ∀ i : Fin n, (zeros n)[i.val] = 0 ∧
  ∀ rows cols : Nat, ∀ (i : Fin rows) (j : Fin cols), (zeros2d rows cols)[i.val][j.val] = 0 :=
by
  intro i
  refine ⟨by simp [zeros], ?_⟩
  intro rows cols a b
  simp [zeros2d]
-- </vc-theorems>
